messages:
jamal: RC candidate ready — sha=abc123def, bundle=model-serve-v2.4.1-rc3. Requesting micro-subset canary (5% of latency-sensitive routes) in the 11:00-11:30 PT change window. Release notes draft: https://go/release/rc3-draft (please eyeball).

oliver: ack. Can we confirm KV-warm schedule and expected warm hit %?

maria: putting up the smoke set: `chat-smoke-5` (short prompts). Will run baseline now.

jamal: KV-warm plan: start prefix warm 60m prior; expect ~70% hit after warm. Pin name proposed: `rc3-20260321`. Rollback window: 30m after full promo. Runbook snippet below.

jamal: Runbook (short):
```
# rollback quick steps
1) /deploy rollback --job <job-id> --to-sha=abc122
2) flip ff_model=stable via /flags revert
3) notify #incidents + @sre-oncall
```

deploy-bot: To promote run:
`/deploy promote --sha abc123def --subset 5 --pin model_pin=rc3-20260321`

jamal: executing promote now.

deploy-bot: Promotion job queued (job id 98765). Starting canary slice=5%. Routing policy applied. Watch metrics: https://console/rc/98765/metrics

srebot: Oncall ack. I'll monitor p95, error-rate, and kv-miss. If error-rate > 3x baseline or p95 jumps > 150%, we rollback.

oliver: first 3m smoke: no error spikes. p95 +1ms. KV warm status: prefix cache hit ~72% (per warm job).

maria: smoke outputs look normal. No hallucination regressions on the test set.

tess: product LGTM — saw sample diffs, minor copy nit in release notes fixed. Approving canary.

jamal: plan: scale to 25% at 11:15 PT if metrics hold for 10 minutes. Waiting 10m stable watch. Any objections?

oliver: none.

tess: none.

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 25% (job 98765 -> step 2).

maria: observability: p95 +2ms, error-rate stable, KV hit ~78%. No alerts.

oliver: updated deployment manifest with pin: manifest v1.12 includes `model_pin: rc3-20260321` and `artifact_sha: abc123def`.

jamal: pin confirmed. Final promote target = full prod. Scheduling final flip at 11:25 PT (within window). Last call for objections.

srebot: standing by. Rollback procedure reminder: `/deploy rollback --job 98765 --to-sha=abc122` and contact oncall via @sre-oncall.

deploy-bot: Full promotion started (job id 98778). Expected completion ~6m. Progress at https://console/rc/98778/progress

jamal: thank you — will write post-deploy summary. Post-deploy notes: release notes published https://go/release/rc3; changelog entry: "improved batching & KV-cache prewarm; micro-subset canary validated".

maria: post-deploy checks passing. Closing the thread unless anyone needs to keep it open. :thumbsup:
